# ankra_cluster_ssh_keys (Resource)

The SSH keys installed on the nodes of a cluster Ankra provisioned (Hetzner, OVHcloud, UpCloud, DigitalOcean, Scaleway, Ankra Cloud, AWS, Proxmox VE, HPE Morpheus). The counterpart of `ankra cluster ssh-keys set`.

There is one set per cluster, so declare one of these per cluster. Destroying the resource only removes it from state: the cluster keeps the keys it has, because no key set is a safe default to restore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_ssh_keys" "prod" {
  cluster_id = data.ankra_cluster.prod.id
  ssh_key_credential_ids = [
    "5d0c3f1a-6a8e-4c39-9f0b-2e7d1c4b8a90",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `ssh_key_credential_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the organisation SSH key credentials to install (`ankra credentials ssh-key`). An empty set removes every key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The SSH key set is imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_ssh_keys.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
